prompt:
Our quant team has been manually tracking crypto trades in spreadsheets, but we need to properly onboard a batch of historical trades into our new self-learning performance system so it can start generating actionable guidance.

Here is what needs to happen:

1. Record at least 8 past trades into the system. The trades must include a realistic mix: both BTC and ETH pairs, both long and short positions, both winning and losing outcomes, and each trade should include the technical indicator readings and macro market conditions that were present at the time of entry.

2. Once the trades are recorded, run the pattern analysis to extract the trading rules that the data supports.

3. Finally, update our shared strategy document located at `/workspace/team/strategy/MEMORY.md` with the rules the system has learned. The original content of that file must remain intact.

The self-learning system scripts are located under `/workspace/skills/crypto-self-learning/scripts/`.
